## Current role

Front-End Developer at RICOH Europe (November 2025 - present). Delivers production frontends in parallel under the CORELIA program for cross-regional European operations:

- 3D Building & Space Viewer: multi-mode 3D viewer (Dollhouse / Panorama / Split) with room-aware navigation, React 19 + React Three Fiber / Three.js
- Tailgating Detection System: real-time anomaly dashboard with live MJPEG streaming and license-plate OCR workflows (React 18, Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query)
- AGL Invoice Management: OCR-backed invoice verification UI over SharePoint and AS400 (React, TypeScript, TanStack Query)
- Qalam Vision: Arabic/multilingual NLP keyword-extraction interface integrating Label Studio
